content.text: Rim 0.7. Need to kill enemies near a wall. Move to the back wall and wait.
Fighting enemies at the west wall to build a debris ramp. My punches keep missing because I'm not facing them, so I'll give explicit directions.
Both winding up; punch the 8hp one (north-northeast) now, then the other.
Nice, two kills. One left nearby, east.
Low on health (20), fighting two fodder enemies close by. I'll kick the one directly north.
Enemy 16hp at southwest, close. Punch it before it winds up.
Kick knocked it to 16hp. Dash + kick again.

I didn't escape any boxes. I'm still alive at 4 of 100 HP in box 1 with 9 kills, and I have about 5 tool calls left.

I never got a pile at a wall up to the 0.7 m rim. Enemy hits cost 8 or 16 HP each and wore me down before I could build a ramp. Punches and kicks also nudged me around the floor and often missed. I spent the last stretch dodging and picking off weak enemies to stay alive.
